text:
paul: Quick UX follow-up from today's dashboard walk: two confusion points kept coming up — what 'sampling' actually means, and the p95 line vanishing on warm heatmap bands.

ivy: For sampling copy let's be explicit: `Sampling — 0.5% (≈ 1 in 200 requests)`. avoids ambiguity between 0.5 vs 50. Also include a short help link: `Why sampling?` that opens the docs panel.

reno: Agree on sampling copy. Also propose naming the fidelity presets Economy / Balanced / Fidelity (so product folks see the tradeoff). Preset microcopy: `Economy — higher throughput, lower tail fidelity` ; `Fidelity — preserve tail accuracy, higher cost`.

paul: p95 microcopy nit: replace terse `p95` with `p95 (95th percentile) — units: ms` in hover + the main stat line. For compactness show `p50 / p95: 38ms / 132ms` under the title.

ivy: accessibility: make the p50/p95 line real DOM text and add a visually-hidden descriptor: "aria-label=\"median 38 milliseconds; ninety-fifth percentile 132 milliseconds\"". screenreader-friendly.

reno: scrubber problems: QA reported difficulty hitting the handle on thin trackpads. let's increase target to 24px min and keep visible thumb at 10px. Also add a 6px invisible left/right padding region on desktop to help reach.

paul: keyboard rules proposal: arrows = 1s, shift+arrow = 10s, pageup/pagedown = 1m, home/end = jump to start/end. Show a small keyboard-help tooltip when scrubber focused.

ivy: about the p95 overlay: instead of full white stroke, use an adaptive stroke (light stroke on dark buckets, dark stroke on light buckets) with a subtle 1px backdrop blur if needed. fallback option: dashed stroke when overlay is on.

reno: color ramp idea — avoid red/blue extremes. Trying: `#f6fbff -> #fff7e8 -> #ffe0c6 -> #d9643f`. will run contrast tests. If extreme bucket fails contrast, add 1px inner stroke to those buckets.

paul: small engineering constraint: computing luminance per bucket server-side is feasible and we can flag classes `bucket--dark` / `bucket--light` to let CSS adapt lines. Can we aim for an "Auto" overlay mode that flips stroke based on class?

ivy: yes — Auto default: overlay visible on desktop, off on mobile < 700px. Provide a toggle in the heatmap menu: Auto / On / Off.

access-bot: Prototype deployed: https://staging.redwood.dev/ux/1991112222 (includes presets, sampling copy, adaptive stroke demo). Recording enabled.

reno: owners: ivy = copy + a11y attrs, paul = interactions + staging coordination, reno = palette + contrast checks. Can we sync Thu 9:00 for a quick pass? 15m.

paul: I'll add the keyboard tooltip strings and a short doc blurb for the sampling explanation.

ivy: I'll update Figma with the explicit sampling copy and the p50/p95 example. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/latency-sampler-ux?node-id=21

reno: I'll run Deque and axe contrast runs and post token overrides. If we need stronger contrast for extreme buckets we'll try inner stroke + higher saturation.

paul: tiny follow-up: can we keep the metric label consistent across alerts/traces? PMs get confused when it says `95%` elsewhere. Let's create a token `metrics.p95.label` so copy is unified.

ivy: agreed. I'll add that token.

reno: thanks — will post the contrast report by EOD tomorrow.

paul: thanks team! :tada:
